A little about me

I look beyond the task in front of me.

Through hands-on executive support, I’ve learned that good assistance is not only about completing a checklist. It’s about understanding priorities, keeping commitments visible, and making sure important details don’t get lost between planning and execution.

I’ve built project management workspaces in Notion, Asana, Trello, ClickUp, and Monday.com, structured Airtable CRM systems, and organized dashboards that make tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities easier to track.

I also bring a creative eye to business communication, from writing LinkedIn content to designing visuals and refining professional profiles. The goal is always the same: make work clearer, more organized, and easier to move forward.
